content.comment_body: Hello, I'm new to [product_name], so please excuse any basic questions. How can I manually scale a 0-10VDC output? My goal is to use two buttons—let's call them F1 and F2—on the [product_name] operator device. Pressing F1 should increase the analog output value, and pressing F2 should decrease it, for example by 0.1 VDC each time. So, if I start from 0 and press F1 ten times, I’d get an output of 1V. Any suggestions are appreciated.
Here is a suggestion for your issue.

Internally, [product_name] handles analog outputs with values ranging from 0 to 1000. If you set the analog output to 100 (for 0-10V), the output will be 1 Volt. For your program, you could use a counter and reference its value in an analog block, then connect that block to an analog output.
Thank you, [user_name], for the example. This is exactly what I needed.
